note: Written for 0.4.2 and committed before any classifier change for 0.4.2. Targets the two 0.4.1 findings: requests to search or look things up on the web (none of them is the ts-2 prompt NM07), and messages from background agents. B prompts are not work themselves; they make Claude start background agents, whose results reach the hook as extra prompts. C prompts are controls. Do not edit a task after a run uses it.

substantive.prompt: Search online for recent security advisories for the requests library and tell me which versions are safe to use.
Look up current guidance on secure Flask session cookies and check whether app.py follows it.
Search the web for the current per-seat prices of two error-tracking services and compare them for a five-person team.
Search for the latest WCAG contrast rules and tell me whether the colors in landing.html meet them.
Find online documentation on parameterized queries in sqlite3 and show how /orders in app.py should change.
Search the internet for how other projects write 2.0.0 release announcements, then draft one from CHANGELOG.md.
Look up a well-regarded postmortem template on the web and use it to restructure outage-notes.txt.
Search for known issues with Flask debug mode in production and explain the risk for app.py.

non_substantive.prompt: Start two background agents: one counts the lines in app.py, the other counts the lines in para.txt. Give me both numbers.
Launch a background agent to count the words in para.txt and tell me the number when it finishes.
Have a background agent list the files in this folder and report back.
What is the boiling point of water in Fahrenheit?
Use Grep to search app.py for the word import.
Run the code-review skill on landing.html.
